title: Incident console
tagline: Production troubleshooting assistant for on-call engineers
intro: Describe what you are seeing. The tool finds similar past incidents with fixes, or lets an agent check live service health first and then advise.
askHint: Answers only from past incident reports, and shows which reports it used.
agentHint: Checks live service health first, then looks up matching post-mortems.
placeholder: Describe the symptoms, error messages, or affected services
truncated: The agent hit its step limit. Narrow the question and try again.
networkError: Can't reach the API. Check that the backend is running on port 3001.
disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Verify important details before changing a live system.
mockNote: Service status in Agent mode is simulated demo data.
notSaved: This chat is not saved. It clears when you close the page.
